name: University of Technology Sydney
summary: City campus at Ultimo, Sydney; Engineering, IT, Business, Design and Health degrees, starting in February/March, July or November.

ib.text: UTS accepts the full IB Diploma if the total, with bonus and penalty points, meets the course's entry standard. Assumed knowledge is written in HSC terms (Engineering: Maths Extension 1, Physics and English).

dates.label: Spring session (July start): applications close for applicants outside Australia

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) (Flexible)
programmes.about: Four years of engineering in which the Flexible major lets you explore several disciplines in first year before choosing; accredited by Engineers Australia, with an industry practice stream.
programmes.ib: UTS lists no IB total on the course page. Assumed knowledge: Maths Extension 1, Physics and English (HSC terms); ask UTS what IB courses it equates.
programmes.selectionNote: Eligibility does not guarantee an offer; ask UTS International Admissions for the IB total the course expects.

flagshipSource.title: Engineering (Honours) Flexible: explore disciplines in first year; Engineers Australia accredited

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology
faculties.line: Engineering assumes Maths Extension 1, Physics and English; Chemistry is recommended for some majors.

notes: UTS sets closing dates by session (Autumn, Spring, Summer) and gives applicants outside Australia an earlier date than those inside it.
Some courses have different international closing dates, shown on each course page.
UTS has faculties for Design and Society, Engineering and IT, Business, Health, Law and Science, plus a Transdisciplinary School.
